Answer: B
Reason: The ultrasound images demonstrate multiple small, uniform cystic lesions (typically <2 cm) within the right lung parenchyma, which is the classic radiological appearance of Congenital Cystic Adenomatoid Malformation (CCAM) Type II. This distinguishes it from Type I (large macrocysts >2 cm) and Type III (microcystic/solid-appearing mass).
